items.title: Jane Bunnett interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 25, 2024

ctx.x: You just rang a bell with me. I think memorable is very important. As the song is done can you remember anything from it? Sing it back.

Yeah, that is very important to me, especially nowadays because there’s just so much. You know we are bombarded by so much stuff, right? Sensory overload, if it’s visual, if it’s audio. And of course everybody’s different. What’s memorable for one person is not, you know, some people find the theme from “Cats” memorable. I want to — double shoot myself. No offense Webber.
